messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert fired: service=api-inference-eu severity=high symptom=5xx error-rate spike (12% over 2m). link: https://pd.internal/INC-1843210000 :rotating_light:

pagerduty-bot: auto-page -> @Jordan Oncall @Sam Eng-SRE (escalation policy: inference-eu-high)

Jordan Oncall: acked. I'm taking this. Jumping to triage, putting incident chat here. starting — can someone paste quick graphs? :eyes:

Sam Eng-SRE: looking — 5xx surge aligns with a canary deploy at 12:03UTC. kvcache eviction rate up, proxy upstream resets. brief logs below:
```
[proxy] 2026-03-17T12:05:12Z ERROR 502 upstream reset uri=/v1/generate user=ctx-xxx
[kvcache] eviction spike: 1200 ops/s, tail latency 450ms
[kvcache] conn pool transient errors: ECONNRESET
```

Maria Support: CX reports from EU: several customers seeing failed requests, ticket queue +1. Customer-impact level: moderate. I can message affected customers if we have ETA.

Tina Ops: recirc idea: route eu traffic to eu-fallback pool (have spare capacity). Recommend temporary route weight shift and kick warm_kv job. thoughts?

Sam Eng-SRE: +1 to routing shift. I'll try warming KV and drain the problematic pods. Running: `scripts/warm_kv.sh --region eu --keys 10000`

Sam Eng-SRE: also running `kubectl get pods -n inference -l region=eu -o wide` to identify restarts

PD Escalation Bot: escalation to next level sent to @Maria Support and @Tina Ops (if no ack in 5m will page managers).

Jordan Oncall: applying edge rate-limit for aggressive clients to 10r/s per key as a throttle to reduce backend load. Pushing route shift now -> https://console.routes/reroute?inc=1843210000

Sam Eng-SRE: route weight shifted: eu-primary 30% -> eu-fallback 70%. spinning up 2x warm_kv workers. watching metrics.

Maria Support: posting status update draft to Statuspage: "Partial service disruption in EU for generation API. We're actively mitigating. Some requests may return 502. Updates in 30 minutes." Shall I post?

Jordan Oncall: yes post it. Include workaround: retry after 15s.

Sam Eng-SRE: 5xx rate down from 12% -> 4.2% in last 5m after route shift and warm job. Latency still elevated but improving.

Maria Support: posted status update and notified top 5 SSO customers via DM. They acknowledged, appreciate the quick update.

Tina Ops: drain completed on 3 failing pods, new pods healthy. kvcache hit-rate recovered to 92%.

Jordan Oncall: marking as "mitigated" in PD and closing the page if stable for 15m. Will keep monitoring for 30m then close thread. :white_check_mark:

Sam Eng-SRE: monitoring dashboards show stable. Leaving watch on logs for another 20m.

Jordan Oncall: final note for postmortem: investigate why canary caused kvcache eviction spike (config mismatch in cache eviction policy). tagging for follow-up: @Sam Eng-SRE @Tina Ops @Maria Support

PD Escalation Bot: incident status updated -> mitigated. PD incident INC-1843210000 closed by Jordan Oncall.

Maria Support: customers notified that issue is resolved for most users, will reopen ticket if we see regressions.

Jordan Oncall: thanks team. will file short incident write-up and link to runbook + deploy rollback suggestion.

(reacts: :thumbsup: from Sam Eng-SRE, :eyes: from Tina Ops)
